oracle.description: On the public /methodology page, the canonical-check list contains exactly 18 rendered-visible entries with the complete label set (ordering is not asserted): robots, ai policy, content signal, sitemap, json ld presence, vertical json ld, markdown negotiation, llms txt, mcp server card, ucp profile, oauth discovery, raw html ssr, agent ua accessibility, page weight latency, store feed signals, platform fingerprint, a2a agent card, hreflang locales. The displayed result-state section associates each of the five states with its complete rendered-visible definition: Pass — the expected public signal was verified. Partial — a signal is present but incomplete. Fail — an accessible surface confirmed a negative fact. Unavailable — we could not reach a verdict; this is not a failure. Not applicable — the check does not apply to this site or segment. Activating the actual discovered 'The five result states' contents link by click, rather than navigating directly to its fragment, changes the URL to https://agentify.ad/methodology#states and leaves the result-state definitions rendered-visible. Managed automation covers the label count/set, all five complete definitions, actual contents-link activation, the resulting fragment, and rendered visibility only. Rendered visibility does not establish in-viewport landing, settled scroll position, absence of occlusion, readability or accessibility; correct viewport landing requires separate agent screenshot review and remains UNASSESSED by the managed adapter. This is a scoped informational check, not evidence of human comprehension, diagnostic execution/classification, score or coverage computation, backend correctness, another product journey, or whole-product readiness. The compound navigation outcome is not fully accepted without its separate viewport evidence.
